name: Maska Chaska
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED (PALM & PALMOLEIN) OIL, SUGAR, LIQUID GLUCOSE, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 341(ii), 500(ii) & 450(i)], BUTTER (1.2%), BLACK SALT, MILK SOLIDS, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE (CHIVES) (1%), IODISED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE AND DOUGH CONDITIONER (223).
